text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes Disease. Given the child's age, limp, and localized knee pain with normal knee imaging, the pathology is likely intra-articular hip pathology such as Perthes disease, which refers pain to the knee. A frog-leg lateral X-ray of the hip is required to confirm femoral head fragmentation or flattening.
